warnings: *** MATERIAL CONTRADICTION, RESOLVED IN FAVOUR OF S-02. *** แบบขยายหลังคา 1 labels the ridge and the king post อกไก่ ค.ส.ล. and ตั้ง ค.ส.ล. - reinforced concrete - while adding (ดูแบบวิศวกรรม), i.e. deferring to the engineering drawings. The engineering drawing it defers to is S-02, which specifies both as STEEL: อกไก่เหล็ก 2C 125x50x20x2.3 มม. and ตั้ง 2C 125x50x20x2.3 มม., inside a roof frame that is steel throughout (จันทัน, อะเส, ตะเฆ่, แป all C or square sections). Three things settle it: the detail defers rather than specifies; the same detail labels its own neighbours ระแนงเหล็ก and จันทันเหล็ก, so a concrete ridge sitting on steel rafters makes no sense; and S-02 gives an actual section size while this sheet gives none. Both are recorded as steel_member with the printed คสล. preserved in printed_as and flagged on each element. This is exactly the §7 case where a sheet that defers must have its target checked.

The two enlargements share one title-block entry and one scale (1:25) and are recorded as one section file, because แบบขยายหลังคา 1 (ridge) and 2 (hip/eave) are two cuts of the same assembly rather than two independent details.
No dimension is printed on either enlargement - they are annotated assembly details only. Nothing was measured off them.
